Not at all a place to stay no hot water no proper locks and weird atmosphere.
Broken dirty place.
Bad quality rooms and regular power outage was there. The owner was not even ready to use generator when requested.

It's got alot of parking space in front , even had a valet. The rooms were spacious and hygienic following modern interior decor.
Bathrooms were clean. It also sports a lift along with other amenities . The rates are pretty affordable as well .
It had a mini cafe / French press just as you entered .The staff was cooperative and friendly but their efficiency and speed could use a little boost though. My overall experience was pretty good & I'd surely recommend this hotel.
